build_XLMTokenizer: build an XLMTokenizer instance from vocab and merges files for multilingual text tokenization
run_XLMTokenizer__tokenize: run the _tokenize method on text with a specified language code to produce a list of tokens
test_XLMTokenizer_bpe: test the bpe method that applies byte-pair encoding to split a token into subword pieces
create_XLMTokenizer_build_inputs_with_sp: create special token wrappers around token IDs for single or paired sequence classification inputs
summarize_XLMTokenizer_save_vocabulary: summarize how save_vocabulary writes the encoder and BPE merges to a directory
